Name: lil' vincent edit
Author: deleted56164987
Description:
[size=4]disclaimer! my mods still work, however, in order to use the seasonal version, you must use the legacy version instead of the most recent one.[/size]

after several hours of struggling and atleast one mental breakdown, i finally learned how to make stand-alone portraits that only replace vanilla.(thank you so much, cozygoaty.)

-----------------------------

like the overview says, this mod replaces vincent's face with a more cutesy one.

it comes with two options, vanilla and seasonal:

- vanilla will only replace his main outfit and the winter one. after downloading, drop it inside your mods folder.

- seasonal replaces all of his outfits with brand new ones. you will need Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] in order for it to work. after downloading it, drop the 'assets' folder inside [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters and let it override.

-----------------------------

thank you so much for the endorsements and kind comments! i really appreciate it :]
